natural_body: Targeted 40% discounts boost acquisition but sharply damage retention.

first.rationale: Current metrics show both activation (-6% QoQ) and onboarding completion (-4% QoQ) declining. Memory_91 demonstrated that activation messaging improved week-one engagement and nudged accounts to first meaningful action; memory_86 showed onboarding shortening lifted adoption. Activation_messaging directly addresses the activation decline without the retention risks of promotional_pricing (memory_73 showed 40% discounts sharply damage retention) or the misalignment of referral_incentive (which works well for established customers, not the acquisition/activation problem at hand). Enterprise_sales_assist targets a different customer segment and won't address SMB activation weakness. A standard_experiment on activation messaging leverages proven playbook (memory_91) to recover engagement velocity while preserving the quality-focused positioning that protects long-term revenue. This avoids the competitor's race to the bottom on pricing. Verification of memory_86 and memory_91 will confirm effect sizes and any boundary conditions before committing the week's single slot.
